# Test fixture: an extract of the Bundeslebensmittelschlüssel (BLS) 4.0

BLS_4_0_2025_DE.zip here holds the header row (all 418 columns) and 38 rows of
BLS_4_0_Daten_2025_DE.xlsx, cut unchanged from the file downloaded from
https://www.blsdb.de/assets/uploads/BLS_4_0_2025_DE.zip on 12 October 2026 (SHA-256
12b7a6ba62807ec9b301eb276f897dc85f99b2292311618dec3749a12d984c91), for the food tracker's tests.
The other rows, the components list and the documentation are left out.
